svg.title: Two-node output feedback: real and estimated temperatures
svg.desc: Continuous ideal controller, C=10 J/K each, h=kappa=1 W/K, K=[4,4] W/K, L=[0.9,0.6] per s. Initial x=[1,0] K, estimate=[0,0] K, no noise, no saturation. RK4 dt=0.05 s. Solid real x1, dashed estimated x1, dotted real x2. time in s and temperature deviations in K.
svg.text: Output feedback: one measured node, two states
solid x1; dashed estimate x1; dotted x2
